content: Mabudor kalam Amittaior fut Yunusor heṛe aišše, hodde:
"Uṭ, he moha šohor, Ninivit za, ar hiyanor berudde guzori zanai degoi ze hitarar naformani ãr sarme aišše."

Kintu Yunus nobi uzan Allar munttu atoroi zaibolla toiyaroil. Tãi Zaffa šohoror bondorot, Toršišot zaibo hendilla ekkan zahaz fail. Hetunot Allar munttu daizaiboilla zahazor bara di zahazor serainga okkolor fũwati Toršišot zaibolla he zahazot uṭṭil.
Kintu Mabud doriyat zur bataš melamajjil edde doriyat en tuwan bail ze tuwane zahazsan bangizaibar alamot oil.

Henšomot zahazor serainga okkole ḍorail, fottikiye tarar nizor nizor devotar hãse handahaṛi gora šuru goillio. Ar uzon homaibolla zahazor malfottro okkol doriyat felai dilo. Kintu Yunus nobi zahazor khulot lammilgoi edde heṛe neṛi bári gumot aššil.
Tehon zahazor keptine tãir hãse ai hoil: Oh! Tũi ze gumzor, tũwattu ki oiye? Uṛo, tũwar devotare ḍako; oitfare tũwar devotaye ãrar befare sinta goribo toi ãra ar dongšo no oiyum.
Tarfore zahazor serainga okkol tara ekzone ekzonore hodde: Aiyo ãra loṭari baṛi, toi zanifarium har duše ãrar kubaigio or. Bade tara loṭari baṛil, ar Yunusor name loṭari uṭṭil.
Hetunot tara fusar goijjil: Tũi ãrare ho, har duše ãrattu kubaigio or? Tũwar ham ki? Tũi hontu aiššode? Tũi hon dešor manuš? Hon zatir manuš?
Tãi tarare hoil: Ãi ekzon Ibroni; ãi Mabudore ḍorai, tãi behostor Allah, tãi doriyare edde fuwana zobinore banaiye.
Hetunot he manuš okkole beši ḍorail edde tãire hoil: Tũi in ki goror? Yunus Allar sarmottu daizargoide hehota tara zainto, haron tãi tarare zanail.
Doriya ošantir uwore ošanti oi gilgoi, hetolla tara tãire hodde: Ãra tũware ki gorile doriya ãralla šanti oibo?
Tãi tarare hoil: Ãre dori doriyat felido, toi doriya tũwaralla nizam oi zaiboi; haron ãi zani, ãr duše tũwarar uwore ei bári tuwan munttu aišše.
Tarfore o oi manuš okkole zahaz firaiore kulsuwaibolla darba šuru goijjil; kintu tara nofaril, haron doriya ulda taralla utaltal oi gilgoi.

Ei harone tara Yunusor Mabudore ḍaka šuru goijjil, ar hoil: Oh Mabud, aroz gorir, ei manušwar foranollabuli ãrare dongšo no goijjio, ãrar uwore nidušir roktor dai no goijjio; haron, oh Mabud tũi tũwar issa mote ham goijjio.
Bade tara Yunus nobire dóri doriyar fanit felaidil, tehon doriyar tuwan tamigilgoi.
Henot oi manuš okkole Allare beši ḍora šuru goillio. Ar tara Mabudor mutallek kurbani gorilo edde manoš goillio.
Ar Mabud Yunus nobire gilifelaibolla uggwa bor mas ṭik gori rakkil. He masor feṛot Yunus nobi tin din tin rait aššil.
